primary: Calibration-only MAE minus protected residual fusion MAE. Secondary: OLS MAE minus calibration-only MAE.
design: Same three five-fold participant partitions as earlier pilot; three-fold inner MAE tuning. Clock calibration OLS, Huber, or median regression; no microbial correction or orthogonal linear/RBF kernel ridge with alpha .1,1,10 and strength .25,1. RBF gamma fixed 1. All trainable transformations fit within training partitions.
inference: 10,000 paired participant bootstrap draws conditional on fitted predictions; two contrast P values adjusted by Holm. Exploratory reuse of previously analyzed cohort, not independent confirmation. No search beyond this recorded model family in this experiment.
hypothesis: Preserving the clock calibration may avoid the shrinkage-induced degradation of early fusion; microbial residuals may add information. Neither improvement nor microbial value is assumed.
